headline: Names a federal courthouse in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, after former federal judge Joseph F. Weis Jr.
what_it_does: This law officially designates the United States courthouse at 700 Grant Street in Pittsburgh as the "Joseph F. Weis Jr. United States Courthouse." It changes only the building's official name. It does not change how the court operates or who can use the building.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 29, 2015.
